cases.description: Certified capacity exceeds the authenticated workload and the successor state subtracts it exactly.
A workload larger than the predecessor capacity must be rejected.
A successor capacity that does not equal predecessor minus workload must be rejected.
A predecessor commitment that does not open to the supplied private state must be rejected even when the nullifier is recomputed from the tampered value.
An order commitment that does not open to the supplied order workload must be rejected.
A nullifier not derived from the predecessor commitment and factory secret must be rejected.
Capacity values outside the 64-bit circuit range must be rejected.

note: This file is the versioned source of truth for the canonical positive and adversarial CapacitySpend witness vectors. Poseidon-derived public commitments are intentionally recomputed by the test harness from these exact decimal inputs so the vectors remain bound to the circuit's declared domain tags and circomlib implementation.
